# terrakube_organization_notification_configuration (Resource)

Create an organization-wide default notification configuration (Slack, Teams, or a generic webhook) that fires for every workspace in the organization, for the selected job status triggers. This is purely additive alongside any `terrakube_workspace_notification_configuration` in the same organization - there is no override or suppression between the two scopes; a workspace with its own configuration still also receives this one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "terrakube_organization_notification_configuration" "prod_alerts" {
  organization_id  = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name             = "prod-alerts"
  description      = "Pages on-call for failures across every workspace"
  channel_type     = "SLACK"
  destination_url  = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/XXX/YYY/ZZZ"
  active           = true
  message_style    = "DETAILED"
  trigger_statuses = ["failed", "rejected", "cancelled"]
  # Empty/omitted template_ids (the default) means this applies to every template.
}

# Generic webhook signed with a write-only secret (Terraform 1.11+ / OpenTofu
# 1.11+): sent to Terrakube but never stored in the plan or state. Bump
# signing_secret_wo_version to push a new secret.
ephemeral "random_password" "webhook_signing" {
  length = 32
}

resource "terrakube_organization_notification_configuration" "signed_webhook" {
  organization_id           = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name                      = "signed-webhook"
  channel_type              = "WEBHOOK"
  destination_url           = "https://example.com/terrakube-hook"
  signing_secret_wo         = ephemeral.random_password.webhook_signing.result
  signing_secret_wo_version = 1
  trigger_statuses          = ["failed"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_type` (String) Delivery channel. Valid values: `SLACK`, `TEAMS`, `WEBHOOK`.
- `destination_url` (String) Destination URL for the channel (Slack/Teams incoming webhook URL, or the target URL for a generic webhook).
- `name` (String) Notification configuration name
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization id
- `trigger_statuses` (List of String) Job statuses that trigger this notification. Valid values: `pending`, `waitingApproval`, `approved`, `queue`, `running`, `completed`, `noChanges`, `notExecuted`, `rejected`, `cancelled`, `failed`, `unknown`, `NeverExecuted`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this configuration is enabled. An inactive configuration never fires.
- `description` (String) Notification configuration description
- `message_style` (String) Notification message format. `DETAILED` renders the full card (org/job/commit, view-run link, sent-by footer). `SIMPLE` renders a single-line ping. Valid values: `DETAILED`, `SIMPLE`.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) If set, outgoing WEBHOOK requests are signed with an X-Terrakube-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256) so the destination can verify they came from Terrakube. Stored in the Terraform state; conflicts with `signing_secret_wo`. Terrakube never returns the secret, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, an import leaves it null (the next plan shows an update), and removing it from the configuration does not clear it in Terrakube.
- `signing_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Webhook signing secret as a write-only argument: sent to Terrakube but never stored in the plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11+ or OpenTofu 1.11+. Terraform cannot detect changes to it: bump `signing_secret_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `signing_secret_wo_version` (Number) Version of `signing_secret_wo`. Change it to update the value in Terrakube.
- `template_ids` (List of String) Template IDs this configuration is narrowed to. Empty (the default) means it applies to every template - this list only ever narrows, it never widens beyond that.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Notification configuration ID
